headline: Other Restructuring
summary: Reliance Industries Limited announced the voluntary strike-off of Hamleys (Franchising) Limited, disclosed under SEBI Regulation 30. The announcement was made as part of regulatory compliance requirements for listed companies.

headline: Scheme of Arrangement
summary: The National Company Law Tribunal, Mumbai Bench, has disposed of Supreme Infrastructure India Limited's application regarding its Scheme of Compromise, granting an extension until October 31, 2026 for payment and implementation of remaining obligations. The order also records the escrow mechanism for appropriation and release of funds, and the Company is taking necessary steps to implement the Scheme accordingly.

headline: Scheme of Arrangement
summary: Astra Microwave Products Limited has received a "no adverse observations" letter from BSE and a "no objection" letter from NSE, both dated 29 October 2026, regarding its Scheme of Arrangement for the demerger of its space, meteorology, and hydrology business into Astra Space Technologies Private Limited. The observation letters are available on the company's website, and the Scheme remains subject to applicable regulatory and other approvals.

headline: Amalgamation/Merger
summary: SJVN Limited's Board has approved initiating the merger of its wholly owned subsidiary, SJVN Thermal Private Limited (which operates the 1320 MW Buxar Thermal Power Plant in Bihar), into SJVN Limited, subject to Government of India approval. The merger is intended to eliminate duplication of administrative and operational functions since STPL's separate existence offers no significant incremental benefit as a 100% subsidiary.

headline: Updates
summary: HEG Advanced Materials Limited informed the Exchange that HEG Graphite Limited (renamed HEG Limited), the Resulting Company under the Composite Scheme of Arrangement, has communicated its unaudited financial results for the quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026.

headline: Other Restructuring
summary: Tata Communications has completed the transfer of its 100% stake in Kaleyra, Inc. to Tata Communications (Netherlands) B.V., followed by Kaleyra, Inc.'s merger into its wholly owned subsidiary Kaleyra US Inc., effective October 31, 2026. The intra-group restructuring aims to simplify and consolidate the group's ownership structure, with no change to the Company's ultimate beneficial ownership or economic interest in Kaleyra entities. The transaction is not expected to have any material impact on the Company's consolidated financial position.

headline: General Updates
summary: Larsen & Toubro Limited announced an extension of the timeline for completing the Business Transfer Agreement with Vyoma.AI Limited, its wholly owned subsidiary, and the Share Purchase Agreement for the sale of its entire stake in L&T Network Services Private Limited to Vyoma. The completion timeline has been extended, though no revised date was specified in the announcement.

headline: Amalgamation/Merger
summary: Aurionpro Solutions Limited has notified the Exchange of a Scheme of Amalgamation involving the merger of three wholly owned subsidiaries into the company. The amalgamation will consolidate these subsidiaries into Aurionpro Solutions Limited.

headline: Amalgamation/Merger
summary: JSW Steel Limited announced that its Scheme of Amalgamation with Piombino Steel Limited became effective on October 31, 2026, following the filing of the NCLT Mumbai Bench's final order with the Registrar of Companies. The scheme is effective retrospectively from the appointed date of January 1, 2026, and Piombino Steel now stands amalgamated into JSW Steel. Consequently, Piombino's authorised share capital has been consolidated into JSW Steel's, with Clause V of the company's MOA substituted to reflect an authorised share capital of Rs. 27,980 crore.

headline: General Updates
summary: Usha Martin Limited announced that, under a Business Transfer Agreement dated 25 September 2026 with U M Cables Limited and R R Kabel Limited, the business undertaking of U M Cables Limited has been transferred to R R Kabel Limited on a going concern basis via slump sale, effective from the closing hours of 31 October 2026. The company confirmed that the required disclosure under Regulation 30 of the Listing Regulations was already made to the Stock Exchanges on 24 September 2026, and this update is also available on the company's website.

headline: General Updates
summary: Affle 3i Limited announced that its wholly owned step-down subsidiary, Affle 3iL Ltd., has entered into a definitive merger agreement to acquire Perion Network Ltd., an Israeli company. The announcement was made as a general update to the Exchange.

headline: Amalgamation/Merger
summary: ITC Limited has approved the amalgamation of its wholly owned subsidiary Sproutlife Foods Private Limited (owner of the 'Yoga Bar' brand) into ITC, with all assets, liabilities, and employees transferring at arm's length. The merger aims to integrate operations, realize synergies, optimize resource deployment, and simplify the corporate holding structure. As Sproutlife is a wholly owned subsidiary, no new shares will be issued and ITC's shareholding pattern will remain unchanged.

headline: Copy of Newspaper Publication
summary: Delta Corp Limited has notified the Exchange of a newspaper notice regarding the hearing of its Company Scheme Petition. The hearing is scheduled for December 7, 2026, or soon thereafter, as directed by the National Company Law Tribunal, Mumbai Bench.

headline: General Updates
summary: Share India Securities Limited announced that its Scheme of Amalgamation with Silverleaf Capital Services Private Limited has become effective following the filing of e-form INC 28 with the Registrar of Companies. The amalgamation is now in force in accordance with its stated terms.

headline: Amalgamation/Merger
summary: Tata Steel Limited announced the effective date of a Scheme of Amalgamation involving itself and Rujuvalika Investments Limited, its wholly owned subsidiary. The scheme also involves the respective shareholders of both companies.

headline: Scheme of Arrangement
summary: Tata Steel Limited announced the effective date of a Scheme of Amalgamation involving itself and Rujuvalika Investments Limited, its wholly owned subsidiary, along with their respective shareholders. The company disclosed this development to the stock exchange.

company: Power Grid Corporation of India Limited
headline: General Updates
summary: Power Grid Corporation of India Limited announced that the Regional Director (Northern Region), Ministry of Corporate Affairs, has confirmed the schemes of merger of its wholly owned subsidiaries. This confirmation marks a regulatory milestone in the company's consolidation of these subsidiaries.

headline: Updates
summary: GSPL Transmission Limited has submitted to the Exchange an Audit Committee and Independent Directors' report certifying that shareholders eligible for fractional entitlements under the Composite Scheme of Amalgamation and Arrangement have been compensated. The certification confirms the company has fulfilled its compensation obligations to those shareholders.

company: Dalmia Bharat Sugar and Industries Limited
headline: Scheme of Arrangement
summary: Dalmia Bharat Sugar and Industries Limited's Board approved a Scheme of Arrangement to demerge Hippostores Technology Private Limited's undertaking into itself on a going-concern basis, issuing redeemable preference shares to HTPL shareholders with an appointed date of January 1, 2027, subject to NCLT and regulatory approvals. The Board also approved unaudited standalone and consolidated financial results for the quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026, and an investment of up to USD 22.70 million in its wholly owned UAE subsidiary, Dalmia Bharat Global Holdings Limited.

headline: General Updates
summary: Emkay Global Financial Services announced an internal group restructuring, approved by its Board on October 28, 2026, whereby its 100% shareholdings in Emkay Investment Managers Limited (EIML) and Emkay Wealth Advisory Limited (EWAL) are transferred to Emkay Capital Private Limited (ECPL), a wholly owned subsidiary, along with the transfer of the Company's Wealth Management business to EWAL. Following the restructuring, EGFSL holds 100% of ECPL, which in turn holds 100% of both EIML and EWAL. The reorganization involves no capital outflow, keeps economic benefits within the Company, and is intended to enable focused management attention and attract top talent to grow the wealth and investment management businesses.

headline: Amalgamation/Merger
summary: Aesthetik Engineers Limited has notified the Exchange under SEBI (LODR) Regulation 30 that it has filed Form INC-28 with the Registrar of Companies. The filing relates to the company's amalgamation/merger.

headline: Amalgamation/Merger
summary: Parag Milk Foods Limited's Board approved its unaudited standalone and consolidated financial results for the quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026, along with the statutory auditors' limited review reports. The Board also approved a scheme of amalgamation of its wholly owned subsidiary, Bhagyalaxmi Dairy Farms Private Limited, into the Company under Sections 230-232 of the Companies Act, 2013. The scheme remains subject to sanction by the NCLT and approval from shareholders, creditors, and other regulatory authorities as required.

headline: Amalgamation/Merger
summary: Belding India Limited's Board of Directors has decided to keep the Draft Scheme of Amalgamation with DC&T Global Private Limited in abeyance due to potential operational impacts on DC&T's growth opportunities. The company will reconsider the transaction at an appropriate time, subject to requisite approvals, and confirmed the Draft Scheme is not being pursued at this stage with no financial or operational impact on either company.

headline: Other Restructuring
summary: Saregama India Limited's Board approved the voluntary liquidation of Kolkata Metro Networks Limited, a wholly owned subsidiary, at its meeting on November 4, 2026. The decision was announced to the exchange as a restructuring move.

headline: Other Restructuring
summary: Saregama India Limited's Board of Directors approved the closure of Saregama FZE, Dubai, a wholly owned subsidiary, at its meeting on November 4, 2026. The decision was disclosed to the exchange as part of the company's restructuring activities.

headline: Demerger
summary: Narayana Hrudayalaya Ltd. announced that the National Company Law Tribunal (NCLT), Bengaluru Bench, has sanctioned the Scheme of Arrangement between NH Integrated Care Private Limited (a wholly-owned subsidiary) and Narayana Hrudayalaya Limited. The company has filed the NCLT order with the Exchange in connection with this demerger.

company: Krishna Institute of Medical Sciences Limited
headline: Amalgamation/Merger
summary: KIMS Limited's Board has approved a scheme to amalgamate its wholly-owned subsidiary, KIMS Hospitals Private Limited, into the parent company. The merger, which involves no cash consideration or new share issuance, aims to simplify the group structure, improve operational efficiencies, and reduce compliance costs. The transaction is exempt from related-party requirements, and KIMS Limited's shareholding pattern will remain unchanged.

headline: Amalgamation/Merger
summary: Aurobindo Pharma's board has approved a scheme to merge its wholly owned subsidiary Auroactive Pharma Private Limited into fellow wholly owned subsidiary Apitoria Pharma Private Limited, with the proposal to be filed before the NCLT, Hyderabad. The amalgamation, undertaken at arm's length, aims to consolidate the API businesses under a single entity, improve operational efficiency and capacity utilisation, and simplify the group's corporate structure.

headline: ESOP/ESOS/ESPS
summary: Share India Securities Limited announced that its Nomination and Remuneration Committee approved the grant of 3,80,500 employee stock options to eligible employees under the Share India Employees Stock Option Scheme-II. The grant was made pursuant to the Scheme of Amalgamation of Silverleaf Capital Services Private Limited with Share India Securities Limited, with the resolution passed by circulation on November 04, 2026.

headline: Allotment of Securities
summary: Share India Securities Limited announced that its Board approved the allotment of 44,02,000 fully paid-up equity shares of Rs. 2 each on November 4, 2026. The allotment was made pursuant to the Scheme of Amalgamation of Silverleaf Capital Services Private Limited with the company, in compliance with SEBI (LODR) Regulations, 2015.

headline: Updates
summary: DPSC Limited has notified the Exchange regarding CIRP disclosures tied to its Q1FY27 financial results. The announcement also covers the Business Transfer Agreement between India Power Corporation Limited and IPCL Power Limited.

headline: General Updates
summary: Sahasra Electronic Solutions Limited has received a No Objection Letter from the National Stock Exchange of India dated November 4, 2026, regarding its draft Scheme of Arrangement for the amalgamation of three transferor companies into itself. The scheme remains subject to further statutory and regulatory approvals, including shareholder and creditor consent, as well as compliance with SEBI's observations.

company: S A Tech Software India Limited
headline: Scheme of Arrangement
summary: The National Company Law Tribunal (Mumbai Bench) has directed S A Tech Software India Limited to convene a meeting of its equity shareholders within 90 days to consider and approve the Scheme of Amalgamation of Mindpool Technologies Limited into the company. Meetings of secured and unsecured creditors have been dispensed with, as creditors representing 96.53% in value have given their consent. The date and details of the shareholder meeting will be communicated to the stock exchange separately.

headline: Amalgamation/Merger
summary: The National Company Law Tribunal (Mumbai Bench) has issued directions regarding the Scheme of Amalgamation of Mindpool Technologies Limited with S A Tech Software India Limited, including convening a meeting of Mindpool's equity shareholders within 90 days. Meetings of secured and unsecured creditors have been dispensed with, as creditors representing 92.40% in value have provided consent affidavits. The date and details of the shareholder meeting will be communicated to the Exchange separately.

headline: Scheme of Arrangement
summary: Triveni Power Transmission Limited has submitted Audit Committee and Independent Directors' reports dated November 5, 2026, certifying the distribution of proceeds from fractional shares to eligible shareholders under its Scheme of Arrangement, in compliance with SEBI's Master Circular. The Scheme, approved by NCLT Allahabad, involved the demerger of Triveni Engineering & Industries Limited's Power Transmission Business into the Resulting Company, with shares allotted on July 28, 2026 in a 1:3 ratio. The certification confirms that proceeds from fractional entitlements arising from the allotment process have been distributed to eligible shareholders.

headline: General Updates
summary: The NCLT Mumbai Bench has admitted Thomas Cook (India) Limited's application for a Composite Scheme of Arrangement involving TCIL, Sterling Holiday Resorts Limited, TC Visa Services (India) Limited, Jardin Travel Solutions Limited, and Borderless Travel Services Limited. The order, dated November 4, 2026, is procedural in nature and provides necessary directions for completing statutory formalities related to the Scheme. The Scheme remains subject to shareholder approval and other applicable approvals, including final sanction from the NCLT.

headline: Acquisition
summary: The National Company Law Tribunal (Mumbai Bench) has sanctioned a Scheme of Arrangement under which Hinduja Leyland Finance Limited (HLFL), a material subsidiary of Ashok Leyland, will be absorbed into NDL Ventures Limited. Upon effectiveness, HLFL will dissolve without winding up, ceasing to be a material subsidiary of Ashok Leyland, while NDL will become the company's material listed subsidiary. The acquisition is being implemented via a share swap (25 NDL shares for every 10 HLFL shares), creating a stronger listed financial services platform with operational synergies.

headline: Other Restructuring
summary: The National Company Law Tribunal (Mumbai Bench) has sanctioned a Scheme of Arrangement under which Hinduja Leyland Finance Limited (HLFL), a material subsidiary of Ashok Leyland, will be absorbed into NDL Ventures Limited. Upon effectiveness, HLFL will dissolve without winding up and cease to be a material subsidiary, while NDL will become Ashok Leyland's material listed subsidiary, with NDL issuing 25 equity shares for every 10 HLFL shares held. The scheme aims to create a stronger listed financial services platform with operational synergies and enhanced stakeholder value.

headline: Updates
summary: Andhra Cements Limited announced that it has received a "no adverse observations" letter from BSE regarding its proposed Scheme of Amalgamation with Sagar Cements Limited. The scheme remains subject to statutory and regulatory approvals, including approval from the NCLT.

headline: General Updates
summary: GFL Limited's Board has taken note of the NCLT Mumbai Bench order sanctioning its Scheme, with an appointed date of April 1, 2026, effective upon filing with the Registrar of Companies. As the transferor company is a wholly owned subsidiary, its shares held by GFL will be cancelled without issuing any consideration shares. The Board has also approved filing the certified order with the RoC in e-Form INC-28 within 30 days.

headline: Outcome of Board Meeting
summary: Sejal Glass Limited has notified the Exchange of its proposed execution of a Business Transfer Agreement with M/s. Magnumtuff India Private Limited. The announcement was made as part of the outcome of a Board Meeting.

headline: Disclosure of material issue
summary: The National Company Law Tribunal, Allahabad Bench, has sanctioned the scheme of amalgamation of Pakka Impact Limited (a wholly owned subsidiary) with Pakka Limited, with an appointed date of 1 April 2026. As Pakka Impact is a wholly owned subsidiary, no new shares will be issued and Pakka Limited's share capital and shareholding pattern will remain unchanged, with Pakka Impact dissolving without winding up upon effectiveness. The scheme becomes operative upon filing of the certified order with the Registrar of Companies, which the company will complete within the prescribed 30-day period.

headline: Amalgamation/Merger
summary: Aequs Limited announced that the Exchange has sanctioned a Scheme of Amalgamation under Section 233 of the Companies Act, 2013, involving itself as the Transferee Company. The scheme covers the merger of three transferor companies—AeroStructures Manufacturing India Private Limited, Aequs Engineered Plastics Private Limited, and Aequs Force Consumer Products Private Limited—along with their respective members and creditors.

headline: Scheme of Arrangement
summary: Hindware Home Innovation Limited has received the certified true copy of the NCLT Kolkata order sanctioning its Scheme of Arrangement. The company disclosed this via a regulatory filing under SEBI LODR Regulation 30.

headline: Amalgamation/Merger
summary: Share India Securities Limited's Board approved a Scheme of Amalgamation on November 06, 2026, under which Ace Alpha Tech Limited will merge into Share India Securities Limited. The scheme is subject to approval by their respective shareholders and creditors.

headline: Amalgamation/Merger
summary: Sagar Cements Limited has received Observation Letters from both BSE and NSE regarding the Scheme of Amalgamation of Andhra Cements Limited into Sagar Cements Limited. The scheme, covering their respective shareholders and creditors, is being pursued under Sections 230 to 232 of the Companies Act, 2013.

headline: Amalgamation/Merger
summary: Sagar Cements Limited has received Observation Letters from BSE and NSE regarding the Scheme of Amalgamation of Andhra Cements Limited into Sagar Cements Limited. The scheme, involving the transferor and transferee companies along with their shareholders and creditors, is being pursued under Sections 230 to 232 of the Companies Act, 2013.

headline: Updates
summary: Andhra Cements Limited has received a "no objection" Observation Letter from NSE regarding its proposed Scheme of Amalgamation with Sagar Cements Limited. The scheme remains subject to statutory and regulatory approvals, including approval from the NCLT.

headline: Agreements
summary: Yasons Chemex Care Limited announced that its 99%-owned subsidiary, Rishit Polysurf LLP, has executed a Business Transfer Agreement with Vasudha Specialities Emulsifiers Limited for the slump sale of its Chemical Manufacturing Business as a going concern. The transaction is valued at a lump-sum cash consideration of INR 29.61 crore, with no related-party involvement. The disclosure was made under SEBI LODR Regulation 30, and the company noted that corporate governance provisions are not applicable to it as an SME-listed entity.

headline: Other Restructuring
summary: Bondada Engineering Limited has incorporated Bondada International FZ-LLC in the Ras Al Khaimah Economic Zone (UAE) as a wholly owned subsidiary, subscribing to 20 equity shares of AED 1,000 each (AED 20,000 total). The entity will serve as an overseas holding structure for the Group's international operations, supporting expansion across renewable energy, BESS, telecom, and power infrastructure. This initiative is aimed at strengthening the Group's global presence and pursuing new markets and partnerships beyond India.

headline: Scheme of Arrangement
summary: VISA Chrome Limited's board has granted in-principle approval to a Scheme of Arrangement to transfer its Raigarh Project undertaking to wholly-owned subsidiary Kalinganagar Chrome Private Limited (to be renamed VISA Steel Raigarh Private Limited) on a going concern basis. The scheme remains subject to Board approval of the draft scheme and related documents, plus shareholder, creditor, stock exchange, and NCLT approvals. The company also reported its unaudited standalone and consolidated financial results for the quarter and half year ended 30 September 2025, accompanied by the statutory auditor's Limited Review Report.

headline: Other Restructuring
summary: Elgi Rubber Company Limited's Board approved the reversal of interest receivable amounting to Rs. 17.03 million from its overseas wholly-owned subsidiaries (Elgi Rubber Company LLC, USA and Borrachas e Equipamentos Elgi Ltda, Brasil) for the quarter ended September 30, 2026, aimed at reducing interest burden and improving their financial position. The Board also approved the unaudited standalone and consolidated financial results for the quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026, on which the Statutory Auditors expressed an unmodified opinion.

headline: Updates
summary: Jana Small Finance Bank Limited announced that on November 11, 2026, it received a copy of an NCLT Chennai order approving the amalgamation of Jana Holdings Limited with Jana Capital Limited—both promoter group companies. The bank clarified that it is not a party to the scheme, and the disclosure was made under SEBI LODR Regulations.

headline: Demerger
summary: Precot Limited's Board has granted in-principle approval for a demerger of its identified non-core assets—including its investment in Suprem Associates, a partnership firm holding immovable property—into a separate resulting company under Sections 230–232 of the Companies Act, 2013. The demerger, which will not involve any listing of the resulting entity, is intended to separate non-core assets from the company's core operations, allowing management and capital to focus on expansion and growth while improving transparency and enabling independent value discovery. The proposal remains subject to approvals from the Board, shareholders, creditors, NCLT, stock exchanges, and other regulatory authorities, with non-promoter shareholders to receive appropriate compensation for shares allotted in the resulting entity at a value determined by an independent valuer.

headline: Amalgamation/Merger
summary: Kothari Petrochemicals Limited has notified the Exchange regarding the proceedings of the NCLT-convened meeting of its unsecured creditors, held on November 13, 2026. The meeting relates to the company's proposed amalgamation/merger.

headline: Shareholders meeting
summary: Kothari Petrochemicals Limited informed the Exchange about the proceedings of its NCLT-convened meeting of Equity Shareholders, held on November 13, 2026. The announcement concerns the outcome of this shareholder meeting convened under NCLT direction.

headline: Amalgamation/Merger
summary: Kothari Sugars And Chemicals Limited informed the Exchange about the proceedings of the NCLT-convened meeting of its unsecured creditors, held on November 13, 2026. The meeting relates to the company's amalgamation/merger process.

headline: Shareholders meeting
summary: Kothari Sugars And Chemicals Limited has notified the Exchange of the proceedings from its NCLT-convened meeting of equity shareholders, held on November 13, 2026. The announcement confirms the meeting took place as scheduled under National Company Law Tribunal direction.

headline: Scheme of Arrangement
summary: Belrise Industries Limited's Board approved a scheme to amalgamate its wholly owned subsidiary, H-One India Private Limited, into itself, while rescinding the previously approved scheme from November 11, 2025. The merger is intended to leverage synergies between the two entities, which operate in similar automotive component manufacturing businesses.

headline: Amalgamation/Merger
summary: Kothari Sugars And Chemicals Limited has submitted the voting results and Scrutinizer's Report from its NCLT-convened meeting of unsecured creditors, held on November 13, 2026. The meeting relates to the company's proposed amalgamation/merger.

headline: Shareholders meeting
summary: Kothari Sugars And Chemicals Limited has submitted to the Exchange the voting results and Scrutinizer's Report from its NCLT-convened meeting of equity shareholders. The meeting was held on November 13, 2026.

headline: Amalgamation/Merger
summary: Kothari Petrochemicals Limited has submitted to the Exchange the voting results and Scrutinizer's Report from its NCLT-convened meeting of Unsecured Creditors, held on November 13, 2026. The meeting relates to the company's amalgamation/merger process.

headline: Shareholders meeting
summary: Kothari Petrochemicals Limited has submitted the Voting Results and Scrutinizer's Report from its NCLT-convened meeting of Equity Shareholders to the Exchange. The meeting was held on November 13, 2026.

headline: General Updates
summary: Rubicon Research Limited announced that the Regional Director (Western Region), Ministry of Corporate Affairs, returned its fast-track merger application for KIA Health Tech Pvt Ltd due to insufficient shareholder approval (88.65% vs. required 90%) and unsecured creditor approval (71.83% vs. required 90%). The company is evaluating options, including pursuing the merger through the regular NCLT process. The order has no material impact on business operations, as KIA Health Tech currently has no operations.

headline: Other Restructuring
summary: Sejal Glass Limited has signed and executed a Business Transfer Agreement to purchase and acquire the business undertaking of M/s. Magnumtuff India Private Limited. The company disclosed this restructuring development to the exchange.

headline: Acquisition
summary: Sejal Glass Limited has signed a Business Transfer Agreement to acquire the business undertaking of M/s. Magnumtuff India Private Limited. The company disclosed the signing and execution of the agreement to the exchange.

headline: Copy of Newspaper Publication
summary: Cyber Media (India) Limited has submitted to the Exchange a copy of the newspaper publication regarding notices for meetings of its Equity Shareholders and Unsecured Creditors. The meetings are being convened pursuant to an order dated October 16, 2026, issued by the Hon'ble National Company Law Tribunal, Delhi Bench.

headline: Copy of Newspaper Publication
summary: Cyber Media Research & Services Limited has published a newspaper notice convening meetings of its equity shareholders and unsecured creditors. The meetings are being held pursuant to an October 16, 2026 order from the National Company Law Tribunal's Delhi Bench. The company provided the publication copy to the Exchange.

headline: Amalgamation/Merger
summary: Shalimar Paints Limited's Board has approved a Scheme of Amalgamation under which Hella Infra Market Limited (HIML) will merge into Shalimar Paints (SPL), subject to approvals from shareholders, creditors, stock exchanges, NCLT, SEBI, and other regulators. The Board also approved supporting documents including valuation reports recommending share and NCD exchange ratios, fairness opinions from an independent merchant banker, and reports from the Audit Committee and Committee of Independent Directors. A postal ballot notice has been approved, with the commencement date to be intimated separately.

headline: Change in Management
summary: SBI Funds Management Limited announced that Mr. Mahesh Chhabria will cease to be a Senior Management Personnel effective November 17, 2026, due to organizational restructuring. The change was disclosed to the Exchange as a management update.

headline: Amalgamation/Merger
summary: Bharat Forge Limited announced that the Regional Director, Western Region, has approved the merger of Ferrovia Transrail Solutions Private Limited (a wholly owned step-down subsidiary) with BF Infrastructure Limited (a wholly owned subsidiary) under Section 233 of the Companies Act, 2013. The scheme became effective on November 17, 2026, upon filing with the Registrar of Companies, Maharashtra, following which FTSPL stands dissolved and ceases to be a step-down subsidiary. The merger, undertaken to create operational synergies between the complementary EPC and infrastructure businesses, involved no cash consideration or new share issuance and does not affect Bharat Forge's shareholding pattern.

headline: Amalgamation/Merger
summary: Pondy Oxides & Chemicals Limited has filed a merger application involving POCL Future Tech Private Limited as the transferor company, submitted under Section 133 of the Companies Act, 2013. The transferor company has 7 equity shareholders and 1 secured creditor, all of whom have given 100% consent by affidavit, and it has sought to dispense with their respective meetings.

headline: Amalgamation/Merger
summary: AYM Syntex Limited announced that the NCLT Mumbai Bench has sanctioned its Scheme of Amalgamation/Merger under Sections 230-232 of the Companies Act, 2013, making the Scheme effective upon such sanction per Clause 20. The certified order is awaited and will be disclosed to the stock exchanges once received.

headline: Amalgamation/Merger
summary: Inventurus Knowledge Solutions Limited announced the merger of Turbo Health Holdings, LLC, a step-down wholly owned subsidiary, into Inventurus Knowledge Solutions, Inc., a wholly owned subsidiary. The company disclosed the amalgamation to the Exchange.

headline: Amalgamation/Merger
summary: Dr. Agarwal's Health Care Limited has allotted 1,51,90,373 equity shares pursuant to the Scheme of Amalgamation between Dr. Agarwal's Eye Hospital Limited and Dr. Agarwal's Health Care Limited. The allotment was made to the respective shareholders and creditors under the approved scheme.

headline: Updates
summary: The NCLT Mumbai Bench has dismissed and disposed of the Section 9 IBC application filed by Ketav Consultant against Rochem Separation Systems (India) Private Limited, a wholly-owned subsidiary of Concord Enviro Systems Limited. This order, dated 19th November 2026, follows the company's earlier intimation dated 4th July 2025 and was disclosed pursuant to Regulation 30 of SEBI (LODR), 2015.

headline: General Updates
summary: Bhagyanagar India Limited announced that BSE Limited and the National Stock Exchange of India Limited have granted in-principle approval for the listing of 3,34,96,434 equity shares of Rs. 2 each. These shares were issued and allotted by Tieramet Limited under a Composite Scheme of Arrangement.

headline: Amalgamation/Merger
summary: VMS TMT Limited has received No Objection letters from BSE Limited and the National Stock Exchange of India Limited regarding the proposed scheme of amalgamation of Aditya Ultra Steel Limited into VMS TMT Limited. The scheme involves the transferor company, Aditya Ultra Steel Limited, merging with and into the transferee company, VMS TMT Limited.

headline: Amalgamation/Merger
summary: Aditya Ultra Steel Limited has announced its amalgamation with and into VMS TMT Limited. Under the arrangement, Aditya Ultra Steel is the transferor (amalgamating) company, while VMS TMT Limited is the transferee (amalgamated) company.

headline: Amalgamation/Merger
summary: Inventurus Knowledge Solutions Limited announced that the previously approved merger of its step-down subsidiary Turbo Health Holdings, LLC into its wholly owned material subsidiary Inventurus Knowledge Solutions, Inc. has been completed. As a result, Turbo Health has ceased to be a step-down subsidiary of the Company, with completion confirmed on November 20, 2026.

headline: Scheme of Arrangement
summary: TTK Healthcare's Board approved a Scheme of Arrangement on November 20, 2026, involving the issuance of bonus Non-Convertible Redeemable Preference Shares. Under the scheme, shareholders will receive 5 NCRPS of Rs.100 each fully paid up for every 1 equity share of Rs.10 held as on the Record Date.

headline: Bonus
summary: TTK Healthcare's Board approved a Scheme of Arrangement on November 20, 2026, to issue bonus Non-Convertible Redeemable Preference Shares (NCRPS). Under the scheme, shareholders will receive 5 NCRPS of Rs.100 each fully paid up for every 1 equity share of Rs.10 held as of the Record Date.

headline: Updates
summary: Magnum Ventures Limited has notified the Exchange of the proceedings from meetings convened under the directions of the NCLT Allahabad Bench. These meetings relate to the company's Scheme of Arrangement.

headline: Scheme of Arrangement
summary: The NCLT Mumbai Bench has approved the Scheme of Amalgamation of Everblue Apparel Limited (a wholly owned subsidiary) with Raymond Limited via an order dated November 20, 2026. The scheme will take effect only upon filing of the certified copy of the order with the Registrar of Companies.

headline: General Updates
summary: NHPC Limited announced that the Ministry of Corporate Affairs has sanctioned the Scheme of Amalgamation between Jalpower Corporation Limited (transferor) and NHPC Limited (transferee), per a letter dated 17 November 2026 received on 20 November 2026. This follows the company's earlier letter dated 22 September 2026 and complies with Regulation 30 of SEBI LODR. The MCA order and scheme of amalgamation are attached.

headline: General Updates
summary: ESAF Small Finance Bank Limited announced that it has received communication from its promoter, ESAF Financial Holdings Private Limited, regarding NCLT sanction of the Revised Scheme of Arrangement. The disclosure was made to the Exchange as a general update.

headline: Amalgamation/Merger
summary: A-One Steels India Limited announced that the NCLT Hyderabad Bench-1 has sanctioned the Scheme of Amalgamation involving its subsidiaries Basai Steels and Power Private Limited and A-One Gold Pipes and Tubes Private Limited, with an appointed date of October 1, 2025. The tribunal also dismissed a shareholder's interlocutory application as not maintainable under Section 230(4) of the Companies Act, 2013.

headline: Amalgamation/Merger
summary: The Sandesh Limited announced that the National Company Law Tribunal (Ahmedabad Bench) has pronounced its order on the first motion application concerning the proposed amalgamation of Sandesh Digital Private Limited (transferor) into The Sandesh Limited (transferee). The order, delivered on 18/11/2026 under Sections 230–232 of the Companies Act, 2013, follows board approvals and seeks dispensation of shareholder and creditor meetings.

headline: Demerger
summary: The NCLT Ahmedabad Bench has directed Globe Enterprises (India) Limited to convene meetings of its equity shareholders, secured creditors, and unsecured creditors within 45 days to consider and approve a proposed demerger scheme with Morabia Creations Limited. The tribunal dispensed with the requirement for shareholder and creditor meetings for Morabia Creations Limited, as it has no secured or unsecured creditors. The scheme remains subject to applicable regulatory and other approvals.

headline: Sale or disposal
summary: Tata Steel Limited has entered into a Business Transfer Agreement (BTA) for the sale of its Tubes Business to APL Apollo Tubes Limited for a cash consideration of up to ₹11,700 crore. The Tubes Business contributed approximately ₹11,375 crore in turnover (8.14% of standalone turnover) and ₹3,274 crore in net worth during FY2026. The transaction, which is not a related party transaction, is expected to be completed on or before March 31, 2028, subject to regulatory approvals and satisfaction of conditions precedent.

headline: Copy of Newspaper Publication
summary: CIE Automotive India Limited has notified the Exchange of a newspaper publication regarding a Notice of Joint Petition for a Scheme of Merger by Absorption. Under the scheme, CIE Aluminium Casting India Limited (the Transferor Company) will merge into CIE Automotive India Limited (the Transferee Company).

headline: Press Release
summary: 63 moons technologies limited has notified the Exchange of a press release dated November 23, 2026, regarding payouts to specified creditors under the Scheme of Arrangement between National Spot Exchange Limited and its specified creditors. The announcement was filed with the Exchange as a press release disclosure.

headline: Shareholders meeting
summary: GOCL Corporation Limited informed the Exchange about the proceedings of its NCLT-convened meeting of equity shareholders held on November 24, 2026. The company also submitted the Scrutinizer's report along with the voting results to the Exchange.

headline: Scheme of Arrangement
summary: Kalpataru Limited announced it has received the Regional Director's confirmation order for a Scheme of Arrangement involving the merger by absorption of Kalpataru Hills Residency Private Limited, a step-down wholly-owned subsidiary, into Kalpataru Properties (Thane) Limited, a wholly-owned subsidiary of the Company.

headline: Shareholders meeting
summary: Arisinfra Solutions Limited held a meeting of its equity shareholders on November 25, 2026, via video conference as directed by the NCLT Mumbai Bench. The meeting was convened to consider and approve the Scheme of Amalgamation of Arisunitern Re Solutions Private Limited (Transferor Company) with Arisinfra Solutions Limited (Transferee Company). The proceedings were conducted in compliance with the Companies Act, 2013 and applicable SEBI regulations, with remote e-voting facilities provided through NSDL.

headline: General Updates
summary: Arisinfra Solutions Limited held a meeting of its secured creditors on November 25, 2026, via video conference, as directed by the NCLT Mumbai Bench, to consider and approve a Scheme of Amalgamation with Arisunitern Re Solutions Private Limited. The meeting was chaired by Ms. Mansi Jain and conducted with remote e-voting facilities provided through NSDL.

headline: Shareholders meeting
summary: Arisinfra Solutions Limited has submitted the Scrutinizer's Report and voting results from its NCLT-convened meetings of equity shareholders and secured creditors, held on November 25, 2026. The filings were made to the Exchange as part of the company's regulatory disclosure requirements.

headline: General Updates
summary: Arisinfra Solutions Limited held meetings of its secured creditors and equity shareholders on November 25, 2026, via video conferencing, where both groups approved the Scheme of Amalgamation of Arisunitern Re Solutions Private Limited into Arisinfra Solutions Limited with the requisite majority. The company has enclosed the voting results and Scrutinizer's Report as required under SEBI regulations and will now seek final approval from the Hon'ble NCLT, Mumbai Bench.

headline: General Updates
summary: Thomas Cook (India) Limited has notified the Exchange of an NCLT-convened meeting of its unsecured creditors. The meeting is scheduled for Monday, December 21, 2026, at 3:30 PM IST.

headline: Shareholders meeting
summary: Thomas Cook (India) Limited has scheduled a shareholders' meeting for Monday, December 21, 2026, at 2:00 PM IST to be held via video conferencing/other audio-visual means. The meeting will consider and, if thought fit, approve the proposed Scheme, with the Notice circulated to equity shareholders in compliance with SEBI Listing Regulations.

headline: Updates
summary: Birla Corporation Limited has received approval from the Government of Madhya Pradesh's Ministry of Labour to amalgamate its Satna Cement Works and Vindhyachal Steel Foundry units under Section 4 of the Factories Act, 1948. The company stated that the approval is administrative in nature and will have no material impact on its financial or operational activities.

headline: Amalgamation/Merger
summary: Amber Enterprises India Limited informed the exchanges that a hearing was held on 27th November 2026 regarding the Scheme of Amalgamation of AmberPR Technoplast India Private Limited into the Company. The matter was heard at length and the order has been reserved.

headline: Shareholders meeting
summary: Ganesh Housing Limited held a meeting of its equity shareholders, including public shareholders, as directed by the NCLT Ahmedabad Bench. The meeting was convened in connection with a proposed Scheme of Arrangement.

headline: Change in Management
summary: Zicom Electronic Security Systems Limited announced a management change following NCLT Mumbai's order dated September 24, 2026, confirming the appointment of four directors—including Shobhit Kumar as Managing Director and CFO—effective November 26, 2026. Concurrently, three directors/KMPs, including former Managing Director Pramoud Vinayak Rao, ceased office as suspended personnel under the same order. The Board also reconstituted its various committees.

headline: General Updates
summary: Thomas Cook (India) Limited has sent letters to equity shareholders and unsecured creditors whose email IDs are not registered with the company. The letters concern meetings convened per NCLT Mumbai Bench directions, as well as an Extraordinary General Meeting for equity shareholders.

headline: Amalgamation/Merger
summary: The National Company Law Tribunal (Chandigarh Bench) has approved Devyani International Limited's scheme of amalgamation via order dated November 27, 2026, which will take effect upon completion of legal formalities including filing with the Registrar of Companies, Haryana. As the scheme involves the merger of wholly-owned subsidiaries into the company with no fresh equity shares issued, there will be no impact on the company's issued, paid-up, or listed equity share capital.
